title: Build multi-page website for Launchpad Studio with demo store and product detail pages

requirements.summary: Create multi-page navigation structure with separate routes for Home, Services, Launch Packages/Pricing, Demo Store, How It Works, Testimonials, and Contact/Book a Consultation pages
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation menu visible on all pages with links to each section
Clicking navigation links loads separate page routes, not scroll anchors
All 7 pages are accessible via navigation

file_operations.description: Add React Router configuration with routes for Home (/), Services (/services), Launch Packages (/packages), Demo Store (/store), How It Works (/how-it-works), Testimonials (/testimonials), and Contact (/contact) pages
Create navigation component with links to all 7 pages using React Router Link components, ensuring navigation menu is reusable across all pages
Create layout wrapper component that includes Navigation component and renders child page content, to be used by all pages for consistent header/navigation placement

requirements.summary: Build Home page with business overview, testimonial preview section, and strong CTA buttons for 'Book Free Consultation' and 'View Launch Packages'
acceptanceCriteria: Home page displays Launchpad Studio business description
Preview of 2-3 testimonials visible on Home page
At least two prominent CTA buttons present
CTAs link to relevant pages (Contact and Launch Packages)

file_operations.description: Create Home page component with hero section using generated image frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png as background, business overview section describing Launchpad Studio's mission, testimonial preview section displaying 2-3 testimonials, and two prominent CTA buttons ('Book Free Consultation' linking to /contact and 'View Launch Packages' linking to /packages)
Create reusable testimonial card component that displays client name, role, and feedback quote, to be used on Home page preview and Testimonials page

requirements.summary: Create Services page detailing brand identity and visual design, website and portfolio development, ecommerce and merch store setup, digital product launches (ebooks, courses, templates), and creator monetisation and growth strategy
acceptanceCriteria: Services page lists all 5 service categories
Each service has a title and descriptive text
Page includes at least one CTA button

file_operations.description: Create Services page component displaying all 5 service categories (Brand identity and visual design, Website and portfolio development, Ecommerce and merch store setup, Digital product launches, Creator monetisation and growth strategy) with titles and descriptive text for each, plus at least one CTA button linking to /contact or /packages
Create reusable service card component to display individual service with icon, title, and description text

requirements.summary: Build Launch Packages/Pricing page displaying service packages with realistic Indian Rupee pricing examples (₹1,999, ₹4,999, ₹14,999) and clear CTAs
acceptanceCriteria: Pricing page displays at least 3 package tiers
All prices shown in ₹ INR format
Each package includes features/benefits and a CTA button
No dollar pricing appears anywhere

file_operations.description: Create Launch Packages/Pricing page component displaying at least 3 package tiers with pricing in ₹ INR format (e.g., ₹1,999, ₹4,999, ₹14,999), features/benefits list for each package, and CTA button per package linking to /contact
Create reusable pricing card component to display package name, price in ₹ INR, features list, and CTA button

requirements.summary: Create Demo Store page showcasing at least 3 products (Creator Hoodie merch, Monetisation Ebook digital product, Online Course/Digital Template) with product cards that are fully clickable and link to separate product detail pages
acceptanceCriteria: Demo Store page displays product grid with at least 3 products
Products include: Creator Hoodie, Monetisation Ebook, and Online Course/Digital Template
Each product card shows image, name, price in ₹ INR, and CTA button
Clicking product or CTA navigates to dedicated product detail page

file_operations.description: Create Demo Store page component displaying product grid with at least 3 products: Creator Hoodie (using frontend/public/assets/generated/creator-hoodie.dim_800x800.png), Monetisation Ebook (using frontend/public/assets/generated/monetisation-ebook.dim_800x800.png), and Online Course/Digital Template (using frontend/public/assets/generated/digital-course.dim_800x800.png). Each product card shows image, name, price in ₹ INR, and is fully clickable linking to /store/:productId detail page
Create reusable product card component that displays product image, name, price in ₹ INR, and CTA button, wrapping entire card in React Router Link to product detail page

Create products data file containing array of product objects with id, name, price (₹ INR), image path, short description, and full description for Creator Hoodie, Monetisation Ebook, and Online Course/Digital Template

requirements.summary: Build individual product detail pages for each Demo Store product showing product image, name, full description, price in ₹ INR, and clear 'Buy Now' or 'Enquire Now' CTA button
acceptanceCriteria: Each product has its own detail page route
Detail page displays: product image, name, description, price (₹ INR), and CTA
CTA button is prominently displayed
Product details are not shown on Demo Store listing page

file_operations.description: Create ProductDetail page component that receives productId from route params, looks up product from products data, and displays large product image, product name, full description, price in ₹ INR, and prominent 'Enquire Now' CTA button linking to /contact
Add route for /store/:productId that renders ProductDetail page component

requirements.summary: Create How It Works page explaining the service process in 3-4 clear steps: Brand Strategy & Planning, Website and Store Setup, Product & Merch Launch, and Monetisation & Growth, using icons and short descriptions
acceptanceCriteria: How It Works page displays 4 process steps
Each step has an icon, title, and brief description
Steps are: Brand Strategy & Planning, Website and Store Setup, Product & Merch Launch, Monetisation & Growth
Visual hierarchy makes the process flow clear

file_operations.description: Create How It Works page component displaying 4 process steps with icons (using frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-strategy.dim_128x128.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-website.dim_128x128.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-launch.dim_128x128.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-growth.dim_128x128.png), titles (Brand Strategy & Planning, Website and Store Setup, Product & Merch Launch, Monetisation & Growth), and brief descriptions with clear visual hierarchy and flow
Create reusable process step component that displays step number, icon, title, and description text

requirements.summary: Build dedicated Testimonials page displaying client testimonials with name, role (Content Creator/Influencer/Coach), and feedback text using cards or slider layout, including examples like 'Launchpad Studio helped me launch my merch store in under a week with a premium brand feel' and 'The website and product setup completely transformed how I monetise my audience'
acceptanceCriteria: Testimonials page shows at least 3 testimonials
Each testimonial displays client name, role, and feedback quote
Testimonials use card or slider layout for visual prominence
At least one testimonial matches the provided examples

file_operations.description: Create Testimonials page component displaying at least 3 testimonials in card layout, each showing client name, role (Content Creator/Influencer/Coach), and feedback quote. Include testimonials such as 'Launchpad Studio helped me launch my merch store in under a week with a premium brand feel' and 'The website and product setup completely transformed how I monetise my audience'
Create testimonials data file containing array of testimonial objects with client name, role, and feedback quote, including the specified example testimonials

requirements.summary: Create Contact/Book a Consultation page with consultation booking form and contact details
acceptanceCriteria: Contact page includes a consultation booking form
Form has fields for name, email, and message/inquiry
Contact details or business information is displayed
Page includes prominent CTA button

file_operations.description: Create Contact/Book a Consultation page component with consultation booking form containing fields for name, email, and message/inquiry, contact details or business information display, and prominent submit CTA button
Create contact form component with controlled inputs for name, email, and message fields, form validation, and submit button with loading state

requirements.summary: Implement modern, premium, creator-focused design with clean layouts, strong visual hierarchy, consistent typography and spacing, and professional footer with navigation links, contact details, and copyright text across all pages
acceptanceCriteria: Design feels modern and professional throughout
Typography and spacing are consistent across all pages
Visual hierarchy guides user attention effectively
Footer appears on all pages with navigation, contact info, and copyright
Overall aesthetic is creator-focused and premium

file_operations.description: Update global styles with modern, premium design system including consistent typography scale, spacing variables, and creator-focused aesthetic with clean layouts and strong visual hierarchy

Configure Tailwind with custom theme extending default config to include modern color palette, typography settings, and spacing scale that conveys premium quality and professionalism suitable for creator-focused brand
Create footer component with navigation links to all pages, contact details, and copyright text, to be included in Layout component and displayed consistently across all pages
Update Layout component to include Footer component after page content, ensuring footer appears on all pages

requirements.summary: Ensure every page includes at least one clear, prominent call-to-action button with conversion-focused text like 'Book Free Consultation', 'View Launch Packages', or 'See Product Details' that links to relevant pages or forms
acceptanceCriteria: Every page has at least one CTA button visible
CTA text is action-oriented and conversion-focused
CTAs link to appropriate pages or forms (not scroll anchors)
Buttons are visually prominent and consistent in style

file_operations.description: Create reusable Button component with primary and secondary variants, consistent styling for prominent display, and support for React Router Link integration for navigation CTAs
Verify Home page includes at least two CTA buttons with conversion-focused text ('Book Free Consultation', 'View Launch Packages') linking to /contact and /packages
Add at least one CTA button to Services page with action-oriented text linking to /contact or /packages
Add at least one CTA button to How It Works page with conversion-focused text linking to /contact or /packages
Add at least one CTA button to Testimonials page with action-oriented text linking to /contact or /packages

requirements.summary: Design the site with a modern, sophisticated color scheme and visual style that conveys professionalism, confidence, and premium quality suitable for a creator-focused digital marketing studio, using a cohesive palette and consistent design language throughout all pages
acceptanceCriteria: Color scheme is modern and sophisticated (not blue & purple unless intentional)
Design conveys premium quality and professionalism
Visual style is consistent across all pages
Overall aesthetic matches a creator-focused brand studio positioning

file_operations.description: Define modern, sophisticated color palette in Tailwind config (avoiding generic blue & purple unless intentional) that conveys premium quality, professionalism, and confidence suitable for creator-focused brand studio, ensuring cohesive color scheme throughout all pages

Apply modern, sophisticated visual style with premium design language including refined shadows, borders, and interactive states that maintain consistency across all pages and convey professional creator-focused aesthetic
